:::{#def-coprecision}
#### Coprecision

Let $\vX$ be a $p \times 1$ [multivariate Gaussian](#def-mvn) vector with $p \ge 2$,
let $i \ne j$,
and let $\vX_{-ij}$ be $\vX$ without its $i$th and $j$th elements.
The **coprecision** of $X_i$ and $X_j$ given $\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}$
is the negative of their [conditional covariance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-cov)
divided by the product of their [conditional variances](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cond-variance)
minus the square of that conditional covariance:

$$
\frac{-\condCov{X_i}{X_j}{\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}}}
{\condVar{X_i}{\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}}\condVar{X_j}{\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}}
- \paren{\condCov{X_i}{X_j}{\vX_{-ij} = \vx_{-ij}}}^2}.
$$

:::
